entry_modes.pipeline: ready selected design + exact chosen upstream handoff; inherit mature decisions
entry_modes.existing_requirements: written/spoken requirements; normalize source facts without fabricated PRD
entry_modes.prototype_visual_refinement: actual prototype + preserve scope + permitted UI changes; template adaptation before freeze

traceable_delivery.note: Actual PRD end-to-end coverage required for tech-spec/task-plan/development; design-source PASS cannot substitute.

design_generation.note: Complete current-source coverage permits generation from requirements/prototype without forcing PRD or research.

standalone_light.note: May omit PRD, but must not claim end-to-end traceable delivery.

contract.notes: 读取当前必需PRD/已选方案/handoff完整版本；建议不自动成为MUST。0–3显著决定的证据边界、收益/代价/翻转条件复用D.rationale与AC，所有关键风险保留；收益执行条件进入实际Packet既有字段，丢条件停止冻结。
